title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the Ampere force as 0.30 N using F = BIL.

title: Friction force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the friction force for part (1) as 0.06 N from the equilibrium condition.

title: Gravity component analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve the gravitational force into components along and perpendicular to the incline.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: For part (1), the student must set up the correct force balance equation along the incline (Ampere force vs. gravity component and friction).

title: Magnetic field direction change
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly analyze the new Ampere force direction and set up equilibrium for a frictionless condition.

title: Minimum field condition
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must recognize that the minimum B occurs when the magnetic force directly opposes the component of gravity down the incline.

title: Final B2 and B3 values
description: Essential: The response must provide the correct final answers for B2 (0.5 T) and B3 (0.4 T).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if force directions (friction, Ampere force, gravity) are assigned incorrectly in the equilibrium equations.

title: Unit omission or error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers lack correct units (N, T) or have incorrect unit conversions.
